title: OPGate
description: This is a add for ajqueue, it only lets people join if a "Queue" Operator is online.
body:
# OP GATE
> A simple Velocity plugin that blocks players from joining unless they are approved through the console.

## 📦 Requirements
- **Velocity** proxy plugin only — do not install on backend servers

---

## ⚡ How It Works
Players must be manually approved via the Velocity console before they can join. Unapproved players are blocked until added.

This plugin does **not** use Minecraft's built-in `/op` system — approval is managed entirely through OP Gate's own commands.

---

## 🛠 Commands
All commands must be run in the **Velocity console**. They do not work in-game.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `opgate addop <player>` | Allow a player to join |
| `opgate removeop <player>` | Remove a player's access |
| `opgate list` | Lists all OP's |

---

## ❗ Notes
- For the first time you must do the commands in console then when you OPGate a player that player can add more OPGate's

---
